reviews.text: The customer service here is really another level. You might think that seems not as important for a pet shop, but when it’s in relation to your own animal, anything is important. The lady who runs this shop is so accommodating, so thoughtful and goes above and beyond. Highly recommend.

I used to get my large bag of Carna4 from Amazon but they now charge $25 to deliver and it takes a week or more. I now order from Fetchy as their service is unimaginable as I get my food the very next day with no issues. Their shipping notices are very useful and not overwhelming often like some companies. Thanks Fetchy!
seamless online order and same day delivery of my cat's specially formulated kibble - it was on sale :) thanks Fetchy! highly recommend checking out this locally based pet services place

I use to always order my dogs food online here for the past 6 years but they increased prices so much and even prompted me to tip the driver after the increase.. found another local place same food same day delivery for cheaper price what I always paid. Greed will loose you clients.

Aug 20 2026 Update..
Fetchy.co is an awesome small business and I'm happy to be a loyal client for years. I switched to Fetchy.co when my dear friend closed his amazing store and relocated.
Fetchy.co is 5 stars customer service with prompt communication & help by Fetchy team especially - currently Johann (and previously Brendan - Sad you left. Wish you the very best Brendan).
5 stars same day home delivery with real time tracking.
5 stars as they carry my go to raw brands for my rescue dog.
4-5 stars with product selection given there is limited product availability for some raw brands / products they carry. However requesting a special product item that they don't typically carry is certainly possible. Overall 5 stars.

Thanks to the entire team. I'm pleased to support as always. Cheers. Roger
So good!!!!  A store for loved pets run by a pet lover.  Good advise and great options.

FETCHY had a great price on feline naturals chicken feast. I just needed it to be delivered whenever but they delivered it the same day within hours with a very sweet handwritten note. Highly recommend for the quality products and excellent service.

I had a great experience with Fetchy
Got my package in insulated bag...and inside I found a ball and a feather wand for my cat. Thank you, guys. That was so cute 😍
Unfortunately, can't attach the photo. …
Well stocked on key items. Very friendly and helpful staff.

I got these for my daughter’s cat Fern because you have a good selection of food for kitties with IBD/food allergies — And she said she loves your online shop. Thank you for supplying us with food for Fern that she both loves and doesn’t make her sick.
Food was delivered on time and had a free treat in it that the dog loved.

Extremely efficient delivery
Personal touch by sending card and treat sample with delivery
Very fast  same day delivery !! Meow!!

I had a great experience shopping with Fetchy! I ordered Orijen kitten food and a few cans of kitten food for my little cat, and everything arrived on the same day, which was incredibly convenient. The owner even included a cute toy as a thoughtful surprise for my kitten. Excellent service, fast delivery, and great customer care. I’ll definitely be ordering from Fetchy again in the future. Highly recommended!

I am so happy and want to share positive thoughts for Fetchy. A friend suggested I try them and I did. I received the product for my dog same day as ordered before 2 pm. Clean package and mailer. Also a personalized note thanking me for choosing Fetchy. Thank you for your service.
Same day delivery to my door with texts to tell me when.  Thanks fr kitties gift enclosed.
WOAH! this is so great, it was so hard finding this food in pet stores! the delivery was amazing! Delivered SAME DAYYYY! i'm literally so impressed . Thank you so much
Life saver! Super reliable delivery, always on time, save me many times already! 10 out of 10

Great kibble selection for senior dogs and my miniature schnauzer absolutely loves the Orijen Senior line! Also very much appreciate the great customer service and delivery service by Fetchy as always!

I've been ordering from Fetchy for several years now, and they have consistently provided outstanding service. Their deliveries are always fast, reliable, and accurate, which gives me peace of mind knowing my dog's food and supplies will arrive on time.

The combination of excellent customer service, dependable delivery, and genuine care for pets keeps me coming back year after year. I highly recommend Fetchy to any pet owner looking for a trustworthy and customer-focused Canadian owned business.

The best pet store! Anna is so kind and knowledgeable - she always goes above & beyond to make people happy (especially the dogs) - truly the best - so grateful to have this store in the neighbourhood.
Anna is incredible!  Love our encounters, very friendly,  and will come in here more often!

Fetchy’s stress free same day delivery has saved me countless headaches due to forgetting we have run out of dog food. I strive to support local businesses but Fetchy has made it easy by being be the best option. Hugely grateful for such incredible service!
Amazing, fast, and friendly customer service! Very quickly offered me a replacement and even threw in a bag of treats

A couple of years ago I went into the store inquire about a certain type of raw dog food. The owner informed me he did not carry but took my number and called me a few days later to let me know that he will in fact soon carry the food I was looking for. Ever since then I have been a loyal customer. Fetchy has gone above and beyond for me and my dogs and I am beyond grateful. Their fast and friendly customer service is incredible.

The customer service is excellent. They offer some of the best products, and their prices are as good as — or even better than — other places. They let you try samples so your pets can choose what they like before you spend your money. Even so, their return policy is very good. I also really like how they email you a detailed, well-organized receipt. Very welcoming service 👍

Fetchy is truly an amazing local business! Their customer service is unmatched, they respond to emails immediately and are always willing to help with anything you need. The staff are incredibly friendly, accommodating, and genuinely care about their customers (and our pets!). Specific shoutout to Loan in customer care. Give them a raise :)

Every interaction I’ve had with them has been positive, smooth, and above-and-beyond. I’m so grateful to have such a reliable and kind team to shop from. Highly recommend!

Just a side note: it would for real be silly to shop anywhere else.
Quick and efficient service, makes feeding raw easy.

Beyond impressed with my experience at Fetchy. I’ve gone in a few times looking for something specific, but I went in today needing a suggestion for the best option for weight loss food for my dog. The woman (sadly didn’t get her name) was more than eager, knowledgeable and helpful with all the possible options - she truly approached helping me as it being her pleasure to do so which I find to be rare in this day in age. It was refreshing to receive such positive customer service. Will be back 110%!

Fetchy has been amazing! I emailed them about a food they didn’t have on their website, and they responded right away. They added it to their site so I could order it, and even sent me a special gift with my order. That kind of thoughtful service is rare and really shows how much they care about their customers and their pets.

The quality of their products is excellent, and I feel so confident shopping here. I’ll definitely keep ordering from Fetchy and highly recommend them to anyone looking for a pet food store that truly goes above and beyond.

I used it for the first time yesterday and I’m never looking back. They deliver same day if you place your order before 2pm and the next day after that. The selection for pet foods is not huge but I was able to find what I was looking for. The package came with a thoughtful handwritten note and an email with someone to talk to or get advice from for your pets diet. Love it!

Great dog and cat boutique shop. It looks like they do their research to get in high quality, nontoxic products. I like the selection of dog food and treats with no funky ingredients. To be honest, when there’s another customer with their pet in the store the staff gets a little tunnel vision on the pet but if you ask for their attention they’ll give it to you! That being said, if you bring your pet in they’ll show you a lot of love which is awesome :3
I love this shop! You can always tell when a business is in it for the right reason, and they truly care about you getting products that your pet will love.
Always the best service! I wouldn't buy my pet products from anywhere, or anyone else! They even prioritized a shipment for me to meet a dinner time deadline. If I could give 10 stars, I would!!

The Best shop for cats and dogs in Canada
Nice service , nice welcome .... Anna is so nice with the Customers and our beloved ones ...
I have been ordering from Fetchy for almost 2 years now.  Always great customer service both in-store and website orders!  Highly recommend!!

I have been thrilled since I’ve discovered Fetchy. I love how convenient it is to order my dog’s food and schedule the delivery. Recently, there was an error with my order and I emailed them to let them know. Within the hour, they had returned with the correct item - before I had even seen the email from them saying they would come replace it. Customer service top notch! Highly recommend.
It's a perfect 10/10 for us. We've been ordering raw food and treats for our dog, kitty litter, and food for our cats since October 2022, and everything arrives as ordered and on time.

Quick and reliable
Thanks for being amazing
Great deals, quick delivery!
I am really satisfied with their service. Same day delivery,  fast and reliable service. My highest recommendations.
The best service ever!! Quality products, friendly delivery and same day service!! I have been a loyal customer for many years now!! Thanks Fetchy!! 💛✌🏻🐾 …

Amazed at how quickly and efficiently i received my order. When they say same day it truly is same day. Great prices and services all around. I was also truly surprised by the gift of appreciation and my furbaby was so happy with the snacks from Fetchy that she asked for a snack right away! Thank you for making my girl’s night. 😊 …

Very reliable! As a new pawrent, I’m always concerned about the food I feed my dog. I needed to switch my puppy’s kibble because he was having a bad reaction to his previous food. I decided to try Carna4’s fish formula, and Fetchy generously included two extra kibble samples for me to try. Now I’m confident in which formula my puppy likes best. They’ve become my fave go-to pet store! Thank you always, Fetchy!
First order arrived same day with free samples and a thank you note!
Great experience.  Great food.  My girls love it.

First time ordering from fetchy and I have to say it was a great overall experience, prices were great and staff were very friendly and helpful, even left a personal written note with some extra goodies for my dog. Will definitely be coming buying again in the future. Good customer service is hard to come by and very much appreciated. Thank you
I LOVE fetchy! They are amazing! Deliveries are super quick and they sent me some goodies with the sweetest note!
Amazing Service, quick and easy delivery! Simple to order, a handwritten thank you, could not ask for anything better!
Canadian in every way!

What a lovely personalised gesture to gift a free treat for ordering! We bought our pups food and it arrived the same day of ordering! We will definitely order from your site again and love the personal touch you offer!

I was a little irritated when after adding an item to my cart, I wanted to return to the same section, but it took me back to the home page.  Beyond that, I may never walk into a pet store again particularly because I have mobility issues and this service makes things so much easier.  Prices are comparable.  Delivery is pretty fast.
Amazing delivery and customer service!!
The staff is amazing especially with our pets, there’s a sweet woman who works there who my dog is always excited to see because of all the treats, 10/10
Consistent and reliable same day delivery

I love using fetchy, everything my two cats needs is available very easily and they also have great products, the store I go to has a very lovely lady that has helped me tremendously recommending me great products and advice, I would totally recommend this place.
The folks who work at Fetchy are helpful, knowledgeable about product, and generous in the treat-giving dept. Our chocolate Lab heads for Fetchy even when the store is closed!

Before tonight, I would have given Fetchy a five-star rating without hesitation. Unfortunately, my experience this evening has completely changed my perspective, and I will not be returning. I’ve always chosen this store for its exceptional customer service, but that was far from what I received today.

When I asked some straightforward questions about a popular pet food brand, the response I got was dismissive and unhelpful, almost as though I was inconveniencing the employee. At a store like PetSmart, my questions would have been answered with professionalism and a smile. This experience left me with no reason to continue supporting Fetchy.

To the owner: If your staff doesn’t know the answers to product-related questions, it would be better for them to admit it than to demean customers. This is not how you retain loyal clientele. I want to be clear: I will not shop here again. As a once-weekly customer, it’s disappointing to have to take my business elsewhere.

I strongly recommend addressing this issue internally, especially with your female staff, to prevent further loss of customers. While I don’t say this lightly, shopping at PetSmart is now a better experience for me than coming to Fetchy.
I was running out of food for my puppy (I wasn’t able to go and grab it myself) and I found this website to delivery the same day! I’m so grateful for this service!

First time ordering, came 3 hours after I submitted my order dog food came packed in a cooler.
Excellent service

First time ordering from fetchy and had a lovely experience. Had the site recommended to me by my breeder and it arrived the next day with link to track the parcel in real time. I received a gift with a handwritten note welcoming me to fetchy and could not have been more happy with my experience. 10/10 would recommend.
Excellent customer service and fast delivery! The team at Fetchy has been extremely helpful, friendly, and quick with their responses. Good selection of quality products for my dog.

The young people who work at this location are super sweet and their service  is excellent. Everything they serve from the freshness of the food to  their service, served with kindness and a smile sets them apart from other locations.

Honestly what a godsend of a company. I used to have to carry a 30 pound bag of food for 25 minutes as I walked back to my apartment in downtown Toronto. As great as it was for getting a sweat in, not so good for my back. The option for same day delivery if ordered before 4pm saved me the one hour trek when my wife failed to tell me we were out of my dog’s food a few short hours before dinner. Highly recommend for anywhere you can use their service but if you’re in downtown Toronto hands down the best option. For the dog food I feed my doggo, it’s only available in one store and Fetchy gets the same food to me without any additional mark-up. Same priced food without an hour long round trip? They got a customer for life!!

I love Fetchy! I became disabled 3 yrs ago and cannot easily buy cat food. This a wonderful solution. Same day delivery and just the best business!
Thank you Fetchy
Thanks for the fast delivery! My Sphinx is very happy :)
They are the best! Super convenient same day delivery, great prices. Love this place!
